title.narrative: Integrated Natural Resources Management in Zerafshon Valley for Equitable and Sustainable Development (INVEST)

description.narrative: Livelihoods, food security and nutrition are enhanced through strengthened sustainable management and protection of natural resources in Zarafshon Valley. It is estimated that 32,688 farmers (50%F, 30%Youth) will adopt NRM best practices; 25 new Water Management Plans will be enacted by local authorities; 500 hectares of communal land covered by forest, pastures and woodlands will be protected and/or re/afforested in target area.
